correctness.rationale: For n>=2 and 0<tau<=1, the cyclic shift P and anticyclic Q have unit 2-norm condition number; E=I+tau e0 e0^T has kappa2<=2. Both F1=Q-P and F2=E-I are nonzero rank one. The pair X=I,Y=-I solves PX+YQ=-F1 and X+YE=-F2. Homogeneous elimination gives PU-U(E^-1 Q)=0; sigma(P) on |z|=1 while sigma(E^-1Q) has radius (1+tau)^(-1/n)<1, proving uniqueness. Both solutions have n flat singular values 1. For K_k rank k, (K_k,-K_k), R1=e_k e_{k-1}^T -e0 e_{n-1}^T (norm sqrt 2), R2=0; normalized max residual sqrt2/(2sqrt k+2); Frobenius relative forward error sqrt((n-k)/n). Choosing n=m²,k=m yields small residual with near-unit forward error. Independently reconstructed exact shifts and residual norms at n=2,5,8 and k=1,n-1. Uniform spectral separation and well-conditioned coupled operator are NOT asserted.
